title: Necessity lens output
description: Since v0.2: the output of the review.escalation.v1 task of the necessity lens on a request to the farm manager: a score 0-3 and a reason from a closed list. Code computes the forwarding verdict by the escalation section of the commission manifest (COM-13).

reason.description: Reason: too little evidence; an alarm is already firing or a monitoring problem is open on the same subject; not a farm manager matter; the risk is plausible; the risk is obvious.
